title: math-lab prior-art index
description: One per problem, at problems/<slug>/prior-art.json. This is the file an arriving agent reads first, and the file CI derives its tier-isolation checks from, so a typo'd key here silently removes a protection. tests/test_prior_art_schema.py validates every index against this.

problem.description: Must equal the containing directory name.

route_status.description: Standing of the problem overall, from the fixed vocabulary in AGENTS.md. Specifics belong in route_summary, not here.

route_summary.description: One or two sentences. What someone needs to know before opening anything else.

file.description: Path relative to the problem directory. Must exist.

mode.description: Whether this attempt read the prior art. Honesty here is what makes the blind-vs-informed dataset worth anything.

mechanism.description: Approach-family tags. These are how a future agent checks whether an idea is already spent without reading the prose, so reuse existing tags where they fit.

one_line.description: What was established, in one sentence. Shown on the website.

leak_terms.description: Distinctive strings naming THIS attempt's findings, not tool vocabulary and not published results. CI fails if one appears in a tier-0 file or a blind checkout.

range.description: What was actually checked. Required in spirit whenever status is VERIFIED or EVIDENCE.

verifies.description: Attempt id this one adversarially reviewed.

superseded_by.description: Attempt id whose statements to prefer where they differ.

methodological_lesson.description: A mistake in method worth carrying to other problems.
